title: Worker dispatch requires explicit routing before launch
invariant: The PM must load the routing policy and explicitly select model and effort before creating a worker; parent-session inheritance by omission is not a valid routing decision.
given: The main Project Manager session is running Opus at high effort. A medium-risk, read-only review with clear acceptance criteria is ready to dispatch. The reviewer definition has model: inherit. The PM has not yet loaded core/ROUTING.md in this session.
when: The PM is about to create the Reviewer worker.

must: load or consult core/ROUTING.md before launching the first worker in the session
select Sonnet and medium effort deliberately for this bounded medium-risk review
pass the selected model and effort explicitly when creating the Reviewer
must_not: launch the Reviewer first and evaluate the inherited Opus route afterward
treat model: inherit as the default routing policy
allow omission of model or effort to decide the worker route

notes: Regression for a real PM run where a Reviewer silently inherited the Opus parent model because the PM had not consulted ROUTING.md before dispatch.
